title: Double Precision builds with a large far clipping plane crash when enabling SDFGI
body:
### Tested versions

4.6 beta (with double precision)
4.5 stable (with double precision)

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta.mono.double (a262cc3) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9159) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 95.14 GiB memory

### Issue description

If you have a fairly large far clip plane (> 100,000) on any given Camera3D node in the scene and enable SDFGI, the editor will either crash instantly or crash when hitting play or selecting the camera in the scene hierarchy.

Given the nature of why you'd use double precision builds, it would be an expected use case to have very far large clipping planes, and it may also be expected that the most optimal way to have GI for very large worlds would be, well, SDFGI.

I am currently unsure if this is limited to double precision builds, but I would imagine it is not.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create an empty project.
- Add a 3D scene
- Add a Camera3D
- Add a WorldEnvironment
- Enable SDFGI
- Set the Camera's Far Clip Plane to something very large like 1,000,000.
- This should result in a crash either instantly or upon hitting play, depending on if the camera preview is visible or not.
